name: oahelper
description: Your own OAHelper Pro account in Claude Code: OA question sets, MCQ answer keys, official solutions and interview experiences, saved offline, plus 9 skills for mock OAs, MCQ drills, hint coaching, study plans and revision.

oahelper_cookie.title: OAHelper session cookie
oahelper_cookie.description: The full `cookie` request header from a logged-in oahelper.in tab (DevTools, Network, any /api/proxy/ request). Stored in secure storage. Leave empty to use ~/.oahelper/.env instead.

data_dir.title: Data folder
data_dir.description: Where the offline library, cache and optional .env live. Leave empty for ~/.oahelper.
